title: The 8 Best Recliner Covers for Chairs and Loveseats
h1: The 8 Best Recliner Covers for Chairs and Loveseats
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for recliner covers for chairs and loveseats, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at recliner covers for chairs and loveseats using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sure Fit Home Décor Stretch Pique Box Cushion Large Recliner Slipcover, Chocolate
products.blurb: Key specs: Box-cushion construction with a separately fitted seat cushion cover, Two-way stretch pique knit, Side opening for manual recline lever access.
strengths: Separately fitted seat cushion gives a closer, less-bunched fit around the recline joint than a single-piece cover
Lever-access opening is called out explicitly, avoiding the common problem of a cover blocking the recline handle
Pique knit fabric holds shape through repeated washing better than a thin jersey stretch
Sized for large recliners specifically rather than a generic one-size stretch cover
limitations: Lowest rating count (1,600) of the recliner covers here, less buyer feedback to confirm long-term fit
Undersized ordering pulls tight across the mechanism and adds resistance to the recline motion
No dedicated cutout for power recliners with a side-mounted cord or control panel
features: Box-cushion construction with a separately fitted seat cushion cover
Side opening for manual recline lever access

products.name: CHUN YI Stretchable Recliner Cover 1-Piece, Ivory White
products.blurb: Key specs: Single-piece jacquard stretch knit, Under 10-minute install, Wide range of available colors.
strengths: Lowest price point in this recliner roundup while still covering the footrest-to-back range
Quick single-piece install under 10 minutes, no separate cushion panels to fit
Wide color selection makes it easy to match existing decor across multiple rooms
Solid review base (3,800+) at this price tier suggests consistent basic fit
limitations: No multi-panel tailoring, so it bunches more at the footrest-to-seat joint than the Sure Fit fitted option
Elastic-only construction loosens faster under repeated recline cycles than strap-secured covers
Ivory White shows dirt and wear more visibly than darker recliner cover colors

products.name: Subrtex Recliner Chair Cover, Small (seat width to 25"), Navy
products.blurb: Key specs: Sized for seat width up to 25 inches, Reversible, quilted fabric, Adjustable elastic strap at the back.
strengths: Adjustable back strap holds the cover in place through repeated recline cycles better than elastic alone
Reversible design lets one side wear while the other stays fresh, useful for a frequently used chair
Small-specific sizing (up to 25 inches) fits compact and petite recliners that standard covers leave loose
limitations: Small size band only fits compact chairs, not usable on a standard or oversized recliner
Quilted fabric is bulkier and less tailored-looking than the Sure Fit fitted stretch option
No explicit power-cord cutout for a power recliner control panel
features: Sized for seat width up to 25 inches
Adjustable elastic strap at the back

products.name: Subrtex Recliner Chair Cover, Small (seat width to 25"), Khaki
products.blurb: Key specs: Sized for seat width up to 25 inches, Reversible, quilted fabric, Adjustable elastic strap at the back.
strengths: Same adjustable-strap, reversible construction as the Navy small recliner cover, in a lighter neutral
Khaki tone blends more easily into neutral or earth-toned living rooms than navy
Small-specific sizing fits compact recliners more precisely than a one-size cover
limitations: Fewer total reviews (2,400) than the Navy colorway of the same product
Khaki shows dirt and stains more visibly than darker colors over daily use
Same small-only size limitation, not usable on standard or oversized recliners
features: Sized for seat width up to 25 inches
Adjustable elastic strap at the back

products.name: Subrtex Recliner Chair Cover, Large (seat width to 28"), Light Gray
products.blurb: Key specs: Sized for seat width up to 28 inches, Reversible, quilted fabric, Adjustable elastic strap at the back.
strengths: Highest review count (6,100+) of any recliner cover in this roundup, strong confidence in fit accuracy
Large-specific sizing (up to 28 inches) covers most standard living-room recliners precisely
Same reversible, strap-secured build as the small Subrtex covers, scaled up correctly rather than just stretched
Light Gray is a versatile neutral that pairs with most existing furniture
limitations: Tops out at 28 inches, so wingback or oversized recliners need the Rose Home Fashion oversized option instead
Light Gray shows soiling and pet hair more readily than darker recliner colors
Bulkier quilted layer than a fitted stretch cover, less tailored appearance
features: Sized for seat width up to 28 inches
Adjustable elastic strap at the back

products.name: Rose Home Fashion RHF Anti-Slip Oversized Recliner Cover, Dark Grey
products.blurb: Key specs: Wider cut sized for oversized/wingback recliners (29 inches and up), Anti-slip backing at the base, Woven fabric with elastic edges.
strengths: Wider cut is one of the only options in this roundup actually sized for wingback and plus-size recliners
Anti-slip base backing keeps the cover seated on larger chairs where more fabric means more potential shifting
Dark Grey hides everyday wear and pet hair effectively
Fills a sizing gap the Subrtex Large cover (capped at 28 inches) doesn't cover
limitations: Lowest average rating (4.0) in this roundup, tied with the other Rose Home Fashion picks
No reversible option, unlike the Subrtex quilted line, so only one side is usable
Anti-slip dots wear down with repeated washing over time, reducing grip
features: Wider cut sized for oversized/wingback recliners (29 inches and up)

products.name: Rose Home Fashion Anti-Slip Oversized Recliner Cover, Merlot
products.blurb: Key specs: Wider cut sized for oversized/wingback recliners, Anti-slip backing at the base for grip on smooth leather, Woven fabric with elastic edges.
strengths: Anti-slip backing is specifically useful on leather and faux-leather recliners, where standard stretch fabric slides
Merlot color pairs well against dark leather upholstery, unlike the more utilitarian Dark Grey
Same oversized, wingback-friendly cut as the Dark Grey version
Fills both a sizing and a surface-grip need in one product
limitations: Smallest review base (1,500) of the oversized options, limited buyer feedback on the Merlot colorway specifically
Same 4.0 average rating shared across the Rose Home Fashion line, the lowest tier in this roundup
No reversible side, so the whole cover needs replacing once the facing side wears
features: Wider cut sized for oversized/wingback recliners
Anti-slip backing at the base for grip on smooth leather

products.name: Rose Home Fashion Anti-Slip Small Recliner Cover, Merlot
products.blurb: Key specs: Sized for small/compact recliners, Anti-slip backing at the base for grip on smooth leather, Woven fabric with elastic edges.
strengths: Only anti-slip option in this roundup sized specifically for small/compact leather recliners
Merlot tone matches well against dark leather furniture, same as the oversized Merlot version
Anti-slip backing solves the sliding problem standard small-size stretch covers have on leather
Fills a specific niche, small chair plus leather surface, none of the other picks address together
limitations: Smallest review base (980) of any product in this entire roundup, least-verified fit data
Shares the lowest average rating tier (4.0) with the rest of the Rose Home Fashion line
No reversible side and no multi-panel tailoring, a simpler construction than the Subrtex small covers
features: Anti-slip backing at the base for grip on smooth leather

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
